$comment: Contract for data/tables/polymer_environment.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; compiled by build/src/polymer-environment.js (D64).
title: Polymer environment
description: The published environmental behaviour of a base polymer (a polymers.csv identity), one row per polymer, category and agent, from a resin producer's or handbook reference. The build attaches it, marked polymer-level and inferred, to every material whose Estimate identity is that polymer and that has no grade-level evidence record in the category. It is shown, it may screen a material out under inference, and it never passes one (D64).

fields.name: PolymerEnvironmentID
fields.description: Stable identifier (PB#####; npm run data:new-id -- polymer_environment).

fields.name: PolymerID
fields.description: The base polymer the behaviour is published for: a polymers.csv identity that materials name as their Estimate identity.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: The environment category (schema/vocab/environment-categories.csv). Only a filterable category other than fatigue and creep may be used; the build refuses the rest (POLYMER-ENV-CATEGORY).

fields.name: Agent
fields.description: The chemical or exposure the reference names, as it names it (acetone; 10 % sulphuric acid; boiling water).

fields.name: Conditions
fields.description: Concentration, temperature and duration as the reference states them, or Not published.

fields.name: Verdict
fields.description: The reference's finding reduced to one of schema/vocab/polymer-verdicts.csv; its Screens column says which verdicts may screen a material out.

fields.name: Finding
fields.description: The finding in the reference's own words.

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The reference it is read from: a retrieved source in sources.csv (POLYMER-ENV-REFERENCE).

fields.name: Locator
fields.description: Where in the source: page, table or section.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Anything a reader needs to weigh the row (a grade-dependent remark, a caveat the reference makes), or Not applicable.
